_doc: #1510 / #1512 The ratchet of the shell-broker migration, now FINISHED: `pending` is empty and stays empty. test-shell-broker-guards.sh fails when ANY app other than the SuperApp compiles libs:shizuku-adb-debug-tools or starts an ADB connection, and when this list is not empty. Cloud Store, Cloud Account, Cloud Drive (silent installs through the broker's stdin door) and the two terminals (rish through a loopback relay, then the broker) all reach the privileged shell through libs:shell-client; only the SuperApp owns an ADB channel.
